offering_description.value: Urban One is a media company targeting Black Americans and urban audiences. It operates radio stations, the TV One and CLEO TV cable networks, and digital media properties, earning money mainly from advertising and distribution fees.

primary_products.value: radio programming; cable television networks; digital content; podcasts

primary_services.value: radio broadcasting; advertising sales; digital marketing; event production

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertisers and agencies, cable and satellite distributors; B2C: radio listeners, TV viewers and digital audiences

end_markets.value: advertising; broadcast media; cable television; digital media

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: carriage fees from cable and satellite operators; other: advertising spots and sponsorships on radio, TV and digital

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and operates radio stations, TV networks and digital properties, selling airtime to advertisers; service provider: produces and licenses content for audiences and distributors

geography_served.value: US national: Radio in major urban US markets, TV One distributed nationally

specialization.value: related lines: radio, cable TV and digital media, all aimed at Black audiences

distribution_channels.value: own locations: owned radio stations broadcasting in urban markets; partners / resellers: cable and satellite operators carrying TV One and CLEO TV; online: streaming, websites, apps and podcasts

regulatory_exposure.value: high: FCC licensing and rules for radio broadcasting

notes: Casino interest is a minority stake and omitted; details approximate.
